description: Answer questions by reading a small table (Markdown or CSV).

tests.prompt:
| Region | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| North | 120 | 135 | 150 |
| South | 90 | 110 | 95 |
| East | 140 | 125 | 160 |
| West | 80 | 100 | 130 |

Which region had the highest Q3 sales, and what were the total Q2 sales across all regions? End with 'Answer: <region>, <number>'.
tests.reference: Q3 highest is East (160). Q2 total = 135 + 110 + 125 + 100 = 470. Answer: East, 470

tests.prompt:
name,department,age
Ana,Engineering,30
Bo,Engineering,40
Cy,Engineering,35
Di,Marketing,28
Ed,Marketing,52
Flo,Sales,45

How many people work in Engineering, and what is their average age? End with 'Answer: <count>, <average age>'.
tests.reference: Engineering has Ana (30), Bo (40) and Cy (35): 3 people, average (30+40+35)/3 = 35. Answer: 3, 35
